result.instructions: Tools for Zoho Invoice, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still unpaid, and how much is owed in total?"; "Show the overdue invoices for Acme Ltd."; "Create a draft invoice for Anna Novak: 3 hours of consulting at 80 EUR per hour.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zoho Invoice data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zohoinvoice_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zohoinvoice_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zohoinvoice_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zohoinvoice_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zohoinvoice_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the Zoho Invoice organizations this sign-in can see, with their organization_id. Call it first when you need an organization_id other than the default. Zoho Invoice API: GET /invoice/v3/organizations.

tools.name: zohoinvoice_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices (number, customer, date, due date, status, totals, balance). Filter by status, customer or date range. Zoho Invoice API: GET /invoice/v3/invoices.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

status.description: Return only invoices in this status.

customer_id.description: Return only the invoices of this customer.

date_start.description: Invoices dated on or after this day.

date_end.description: Invoices dated on or before this day.

tools.name: zohoinvoice_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its line items, taxes, payments applied, balance, status and the customer. Zoho Invoice API: GET /invoice/v3/invoices/{invoice_id}.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

tools.name: zohoinvoice_list_contacts
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (contacts of type customer): name, company, email, phone and outstanding receivables. Search by text to find one. Zoho Invoice API: GET /invoice/v3/contacts.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

search_text.description: Match name, company or email containing this text.

tools.name: zohoinvoice_get_contact
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer (contact): name, company, email, phone, billing address and payment terms. Zoho Invoice API: GET /invoice/v3/contacts/{contact_id}.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

tools.name: zohoinvoice_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List the products and services you can put on an invoice (name, rate, description, tax, unit). Use an item id as a line item in zohoinvoice_create_invoice. Zoho Invoice API: GET /invoice/v3/items.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

tools.name: zohoinvoice_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice draft
tools.description: Create an invoice as a DRAFT for a customer, with line items. It does not send the invoice or email the customer. Use zohoinvoice_mark_invoice_sent or zohoinvoice_email_invoice after it is checked. Zoho Invoice API: POST /invoice/v3/invoices.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

item_id.description: An item id from zohoinvoice_list_items. Optional: give a name and rate instead.

name.description: The line name, when no item_id is given.

rate.description: The unit price, in the invoice currency.

date.description: The invoice date. Default: today in Zoho.

reference_number.description: Your own reference, for example a purchase order.

tools.name: zohoinvoice_mark_invoice_sent
tools.title: Mark an invoice as sent
tools.description: Change an invoice status to sent. It does not email the customer. Calling it again on a sent invoice changes nothing. Zoho Invoice API: POST /invoice/v3/invoices/{invoice_id}/status/sent.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

tools.name: zohoinvoice_void_invoice
tools.title: Void an invoice
tools.description: Void an invoice: it stays in the books with a void status and no balance is due. Use it to cancel an invoice that was sent. Zoho Invoice API: POST /invoice/v3/invoices/{invoice_id}/status/void.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

tools.name: zohoinvoice_email_invoice
tools.title: Email an invoice to the customer
tools.description: Email an invoice to one or more addresses, with an optional PDF attachment. The customer receives the email at once; it cannot be recalled. Zoho Invoice API: POST /invoice/v3/invoices/{invoice_id}/email.

organization_id.description: The organization id. Optional: defaults to the organization chosen at sign-in (see zohoinvoice_list_organizations).

subject.description: The email subject. Default: the Zoho template subject.

body.description: The email body. Default: the Zoho template body.

send_attachment.description: Attach the invoice PDF. Default: Zoho's setting.

annotations.title: Email an invoice to the customer

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Zoho Invoice
prompts.description: What you can do with Zoho Invoice here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_unpaid_and_overdue_invoices
prompts.title: Review unpaid and overdue invoices
prompts.description: List invoices, filtered by status, customer or date range, with totals and balance. Open one invoice to see its line items and payments.

prompts.name: look_up_a_customer_and_its_details
prompts.title: Look up a customer and its details
prompts.description: Search customers by name, company or email. Open one customer to see its billing address and payment terms.

prompts.name: find_the_items_to_put_on_an_invoice
prompts.title: Find the items to put on an invoice
prompts.description: List the products and services with their rates, descriptions, taxes and units. Use them as line items on an invoice.

prompts.name: draft_an_invoice_for_a_customer
prompts.title: Draft an invoice for a customer
prompts.description: Create an invoice as a draft with its line items. The draft is not sent and the customer is not emailed, so check it first.

prompts.name: send_a_checked_invoice_to_the_customer
prompts.title: Send a checked invoice to the customer
prompts.description: Mark a draft as sent, or email the invoice to one or more addresses with an optional PDF. An email cannot be recalled.

prompts.name: cancel_a_sent_invoice
prompts.title: Cancel a sent invoice
prompts.description: Void an invoice that was sent. It stays in the books with a void status and no balance due.
